text: Lead check Sept 30 applied after re-verifying every named domain. Dropped: Mustang Service Center and All Auto Service & Body (both have live sites now). Held: Adams Brothers Roof Repair (likely a lead-generation listing, confirm it is real before any demo or outreach). Kept after checking: GM AUTO CARE (gmautocare.com is an unrelated Illinois shop; 648 reviews now), Top Tier (its old domain redirects to spam), 24/7 Diesel (domains expired or parked), A & B Muffler, NO LIMITS, Fenix, Rios (their matching domains belong to other businesses). Prime Time and Bamian already own an unused domain, a pitch point. Open decisions: price, mailing address, Texas phone registration, where the team works the list.
author: Jamey
